structure.unit: Family Offenses; Crimes Against Children, etc

law.catch_line: Placing or leaving spouse for prostitution; penalty
law.text: Any person who, by force, fraud, intimidation, or threats, places or leaves or procures any other person to place or leave his spouse in a bawdy place for the purpose of prostitution or unlawful sexual intercourse, anal intercourse, cunnilingus, fellatio, or anilingus is guilty of pandering, punishable as a Class 4 felony.
